title: villages_fwaystonesCompat
description: This datapack adds compatibility between various village mods and fabric waystones
body:
# Villages & Waystones Fabric Compatibility

A unified compatibility datapack designed to bridge the gap between popular village overhaul mods and **Fabric Waystones (fwaystones)**. 

This pack ensures that waystones correctly spawn in structures that were originally designed with Forge-specific waystone IDs, preventing missing blocks or broken worldgen.

---

## Supported Mods
This datapack provides full integration for:
*   **Integrated Villages**
*   **CTOV** (ChoiceTheorem's Overhauled Villages)
*   **Towns and Towers** (T&T)
*   **SkyVillages**

---

## Requirements
To function correctly, this datapack requires the following mods to be installed on your Fabric instance:
1.  **[Fabric Waystones (fwaystones)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/waystones-fabric)**
2.  **[Lithostitched](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/lithostitched)** (Required for worldgen modifiers)
3.  **[CristelLib](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cristel-lib)** (Core dependency for supported village mods)

---

## Installation

### For Single Player
1.  Navigate to your world folder (`.minecraft/saves/your-world-name`).
2.  Open the `datapacks` folder.
3.  Drop the `villages_fwaystonesCompat.zip` (or folder) into it.
4.  Run `/reload` in-game.

### For Modpacks (Recommended)
Use **[Paxi](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/paxi)** or **[OpenLoader](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/openloader)** to load this as a global datapack. Place it in the respective `config/paxi/datapacks` or `config/openloader/data` folder to ensure it applies to all new worlds automatically.

---

## Features
*   **Namespace Patching:** Automatically replaces `waystones:waystone` with `fwaystones:waystone` in structure NBTs.
*   **Structure Pool Injection:** Uses Lithostitched modifiers to inject waystones into various village variants (Small, Medium, Large, and Outposts).
*   **Optimized Compatibility:** Designed to work alongside CristelLib's dynamic worldgen systems.
